description_en: Use this API to query inbound call records by criteria
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以根据条件查询来电通话记录
name: CloudQueryIbCdr

parameters.help_en: If specified, the system ignores all other filter parameters and queries only the record that matches this unique ID
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明： 1:座席接听 2:已呼叫座席，座席未接听 3:系统接听 4:系统未接听-IVR配置错误 5:系统未接听-停机 6:系统未接听-欠费 7:系统未接听-黑名单 8:系统未接听-未注册 9:系统未接听-彩铃 11:系统未接听-呼叫超出营帐中设置的最大限制 12:系统未接听-客户呼入系统后在系统未应答前挂机 13:其他错误 14:未进入队列 15:队列中放弃 16:队列中超时溢出 17:队列中无座席溢出 18:无座席未进入队列 19:队列满未进入队列
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province of the customer's phone number. For example, `Sichuan`. If you leave this parameter empty, the system queries records from all provinces. The value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city of the customer's phone number. For example, `Chengdu`. If you leave this parameter empty, the system queries records from all cities. The value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en: Specifies how the time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` applies to the query. This parameter is used only when both `StartTime` and `EndTime` are specified. Valid values are `1` for call start time and `2` for call end time. Default: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` must be within the same calendar month. Default: The first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` must be within the same calendar month. Default: The last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The offset for pagination. The value must be `0` or greater. Default: `0`
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 1,000. Default: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of the custom field to use for filtering. You must also specify `UserFieldValue` if you use this parameter. Queries support only a single custom field. Fuzzy matching is not supported. The query condition is constructed in the format `{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}`. The value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配， 构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of the custom field to use for filtering. You must also specify `UserFieldkey` if you use this parameter. Queries support only a single custom field. Fuzzy matching is not supported. The query condition is constructed in the format `{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}`. The value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配， 构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. You can specify multiple agent IDs by separating them with commas (`,`)
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号,此字段支持传入多个座席工号，使用英文半角逗号隔开
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The queue ID. A value of `-1` indicates that the call did not enter a queue
parameters.help_zh: 队列号 参数说明：-1: 未进入队列
parameters.name: qno

parameters.help_en: The reason for leaving the queue. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh: 离开队列原因 参数说明： 2: 队列中放弃 , 3: 队列中超时溢出 , 4: 队列中无座席溢出
parameters.name: leave_queue_code

parameters.help_en: The reason for not entering the queue. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh: 未进入队列原因 参数说明： 4: 无座席未进入队列 , 3: 队列满未进入队列
parameters.name: join_queue_code
